AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE:
This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Planning Commissioners will attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed.
The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. You will be muted upon entry. The host will unmute you when it is your turn to speak. If you wish to speak during the meeting, email CDPW@PVEstates.org with (1) your name, (2) the project address on which you'd like to speak, and (3) the phone number and/or Zoom name from which you will be calling in to the meeting no later than 6:30 PM on December 15, 2020.
If you wish to show any visual aids while you speak during the meeting, you may submit a PDF version (maximum 20 slides) no later than 12PM on December 15 to CDPW@PVEstates.org. Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  DECEMBER 15, 2020
Via Zoom Teleconference  Tuesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  December 15, 2020
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  6:30 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Lazzaro, Criley, Walker
Absent:  None
Also present: Acting Planning & Building Director Brianna Rindge, Planner Brenna Wengert, Assistant
  City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT CALENDAR

5.  CDP-119-20 & M-1397-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1211); Consideration of a Coastal
  Development Permit and Miscellaneous Application for a remodel and 321 ft2 addition including
  new hardscape and structures within 50’ of bluff edge, walls exceeding 42” within the setback, site
  walls up to 7’-11”, barbeque, and relocated pool equipment at 141 Rocky Point Road. Lot 29, Tract
  17606. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14,
  Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Rainville Design Studio, 1632 Aviation Blvd, Redondo Beach, CA 90278
  Owner: Leo Nordine

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following additional conditions: 1. The owner shall provide for the planting of street
  trees adjacent to the site of the building in accordance with the recommendation of the Public Works
  Director or authorized designee. Any property owner requesting to deviate from this condition shall
  be file an application to be reviewed by the Parklands Committee, including requests to plant a different
  tree or a request to not plant a tree as required by this condition; 2. A landscape plan and certification
  are required for compliance with the State Model Water Efficiency Landscape Ordinance; 3. All
  nonstandard encroachments shall be removed from any Parkland adjacent to the subject property; 4.
  The project shall comply with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in
  Municipal Code 13.08.060; 5. City Staff should confirm that the Consultant (R.C.E. / G.E.) has signed
  the final dated grading and foundation/construction and landscaping plans, per City Code, thereby
  verifying the plans' geotechnical conformance with the Consultant's original report and associated
  addenda; and 6. An as built geotechnical report should be prepared by the project geotechnical
  consultant following grading/construction of the subject site improvements. The report should include
  the results of all field density testing, depth of reprocessing and recompaction, as well as a map

   depicting the limits of grading, locations of all density testing, and conditions exposed during
  grading/excavation. The report should include conclusions and recommendations regarding applicable
  setbacks, foundation recommendations, slope stability, erosion control, and other relevant geotechnical
  aspects of the site.

NEW BUSNESS

1.  M-1420-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1207); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  structures exceeding 42” within the setback adjacent to the street located at 1145 Via Zumaya. Lot
  11, Block 2326, Tract 6890. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Alan McGregor, 16332 Bradbury Lane, Huntington Beach, CA 92647
  Owner: Hugo & Calpana Hool
  Speakers: None

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following additional condition: Pedestrian & vehicular gate shall not be of solid
  design (i.e. slatting or wrought iron instead of solid wood).

2.  M-1422-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1208); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for structures exceeding 42” within the front yard setback adjacent to the street of the property
  located at 1805 Via Coronel. Lot 9, Block 2, Tract 8043. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Buchmann Design, 746 4th St., Hermosa Beach, CA 90254
  Owner: Jim & Selmira D’Angelo
  Speakers: None

  Action: Wade moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions.

3.  NC-1684-20/G-1645-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1209); Consideration of Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Grading Applications for a new single-family home at 2304 Paseo Del Mar. Lot
  2, Tract 6888, Block 2212. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Brandon Architects, 151 Kalmus Dr., Suite G-1, Costa Mesa, CA 92626
  Owner: Johnny & Carol Hong
  Speakers: Stanton Hunton, René Hunton, Marlene Breene, Kristin Sweet-Pakarek

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following additional conditions: 1. The project shall comply with the City’s
  municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code
  13.08.060.; 2. All tree removal and/or topping of trees requires application to the Parklands
  Committee with approval by City Council; 3. Lighting within 40 feet of the rear property line may
  only consist of Dark Sky lighting; 4. Pool equipment may be no closer than 15 feet to the rear
  property line; 5. The driveway gate shall not be of solid design (i.e. slatting or wrought iron instead

December 15, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   of solid wood); and 6. Within 10 feet of the rear wall, all vegetation shall be maintained no taller
  than 5 feet from grade.

4.  NC-1682-20/M-1421-20/G-1644-20;  Consideration  of  Neighborhood  Compatibility,
  Miscellaneous, and Grading Applications for a single-family residence at 2000 Noya Place. Lot 71,
  Tract 30905. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title
  14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Jeffrey A. Dahl, 1102 Main Street, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner: Nick & Carly Keefe
  Speakers: Rita Coty, Renee Sanacore, Rob Coty, Silvia Van Dusen, Bob Van Dusen

  Action: Continued.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

6.  Minor Modification Discussion

  Speakers: Keith Johnson, Marlene Breene, Janine Nendick

  Action: Planning Commission noted that, moving forward, they will add conditions of approval on
  a project-by-project basis to decrease potential for abuse of the Minor Modification process and
  directed staff to: 1) create a website on which to post all plans approved by Minor Modification
  moving forward and add the website address to the notices; 2) add City Hall’s phone number to
  Minor Modification notices; 3) return with research and options for zoning text amendments that
  will clarify the scope of work approvable through a Minor Modification and create a definition for
  the word “attached” and other potential definition additions to Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code.

7.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

8.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

9.  Meeting of November 17, 2020.

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve (4-0 in favor).

Adjourned at 10:49 P.M. to the January 19, 2021 meeting.
